metadata.title: PlanNode - Project Planning Application
metadata.description: PlanNode is an innovative project planning application that helps teams manage tasks, deadlines, and resources efficiently and clearly.

hero.headline:
Plan projects.
Deliver results.
hero.subheadline: PlanNode helps your team manage tasks, deadlines, and resources — clearly and efficiently.
hero.free_note: Always free · No credit card required

problemSolution.title: What does PlanNode offer?
before_items: Tasks scattered across emails and spreadsheets
Hard to tell who is responsible for what
No single source of truth for the team
after_items: All tasks in one organized place
One shared hub for the whole team

items.title: Visual project boards
items.description: Organize tasks with drag-and-drop boards. See the full picture at a glance.

items.title: Deadline tracking
items.description: Set milestones and get notified before deadlines slip. Stay on schedule.

items.title: Team collaboration
items.description: Assign tasks, leave comments, and keep everyone in sync — in one place.

items.title: Polish & English
items.description: Fully bilingual interface. Switch between PL and EN at any time without losing context.

items.question: Is PlanNode really free?
items.answer: Yes — PlanNode is completely free. No credit card, no hidden fees, no trial period.

items.question: Which languages does the app support?
items.answer: The interface is available in Polish and English. You can switch languages at any time without losing any data.

items.question: How many people can collaborate on a project?
items.answer: You can invite as many team members as you need to your projects — there is no limit.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Your data is stored in a secure infrastructure with encryption in transit and at rest.

cta.subtitle: Join teams that plan smarter with PlanNode.
